reviews.snippet: The food was talked up about by the guy on the double decker bus so we decided to chevk it out. We were hoping for a wow experience of flavor but were left disappointed. The polulled pork had a good smokey flavor but it was cold, the bun was soggy and the bbq saiuce was runny with little to no flavor. I got the beans on the side and these were also served cold and swimming in juice. I prefer to eat beans with a fork not like a bean soup. The bar was small and had a good small town feel to it. However, the bartender wasn't friendly at all. I would say 3/10 for my overall rating

reviews.snippet: Man I hate to leave such a negative review especially with the workers being so nice. And I understand there is a lot of competition when it comes to ribs. But I spent almost $50 for the beef and pork ribs and they were tougher than a baked overcooked porkchop. Idk if it's just bad meat or lack of experience cooking ribs but I hope they make improvements. I plan to try the brisket and will update my review. As far as ribs, this is NOT where you want to go.

reviews.snippet: I'd just like to leave an honest review of this place bc I can not for the life of my understand how the rating was a 4.8. This was some of the worst bbq I've ever paid money for. The meat was dry and tough and the maccaroni tasted like a nasty off-brand something from a box with bacon bits sprinkled in. The bread was just plain white bread straight up pulled out the wonderbread loaf. Not toasted. No butter. It was truly terrible and horribly overpriced. DO NOT RECOMMEND!

reviews.snippet: I thought about sharing this for a couple days. I have been visiting this truck at least once maybe twice a week while I'm out Ubering. I went on Monday and got what I always get, which is a brisket and sausage sandwich (Large), but on Monday I notice something different. When I paid I heard the lady with blondish/brown hair ask the older lady did she tip? ( She tried to whisper) The older lady looked at her screen and shook her head no. I'm like hmmm....ok I get my food and leave and open my food they gave me a small sandwich and the potato salad was not homemade. The younger lady also made my sandwich behind the screen which is also weird! I'm disappointed because a tip is a choice. Unfortunately, I have to find a new spot. Truly disappointed. The food is really good though.

reviews.snippet: I was not satisfied with the brisket and sausage large sandwich for $15.00. The portion size was not adequate for the price it was akin to a small sandwich. In addition, the shredded brisket was stale. I would not be returning to this establishment and will not recommend Brown's BBQ to anyone.
